draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.40, the 20th-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 5th of 36 at WR. He went 39th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Puka Nacua. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 881 receiving yards in 2025, 12th of 36 WRs in his class with stats.
